concept: A — 先别落地 / DON’T LAND YET
core_sentence: Every new person consumes a piece of the ground, so an expanding group must choose between keeping its last foothold and allowing one more person to exist.
new_noun: 生地 (working internal term; do not force explanatory text into the film)

nearest_works.title: Balance
nearest_works.difference: Both make mutual bodily dependence visible on a floating support. Balance preserves one platform while people compete around a new object; this premise irreversibly converts support into additional people. Consumption, birth and a choice to admit a newcomer must stay legible to earn the distance.

nearest_works.title: Day & Night
nearest_works.difference: Writer comparator: worlds inside bodies are a visual overlap; material becoming a new persistent person with a support cost is a different causal rule. This pass did not independently reopen the film.

nearest_works.title: The Sorcerer’s Apprentice (Fantasia segment)
nearest_works.difference: Writer comparator: multiplication escalating beyond control is familiar; births here consume safety and eventually become deliberate. This pass did not independently reopen the film.

nearest_works.title: Wide Open — The Chemical Brothers
nearest_works.difference: The production page documents a dancer changing bodily material. Our material changes must create new partners and measurable holes, not merely decorate an existing solo dancer.

formal_invention: Contact-position match cuts and conservation of material make a style transition show a birth and a missing foothold; overhead returns let the spectator count the cost. The form carries meaning beyond a catalogue of techniques.

complaint: The film prioritizes delightful impossible physical action over an explanatory AI-history lesson; many names reward a second viewing.
notes: Selected for the clearest first-view physical hook. Pass is a concept decision, not approval of the eventual animation.

Resolve the literal rule before shot production: every surface touched would also awaken clothing, existing people and handholds. State that designated unawakened ground patches are consumed once; demonstrated exceptions must match the staging.

Reconcile ending timing: concepts.md puts the final-platform choice at 19.67–22.70; episode.md places awakening at 34.21. Keep one authoritative final choice and treat earlier lift as temporary suspension, not a solved escape.

Make the ending pay its rule: show how the earlier births provide the arms, cloth or momentum that permits the last catch. If arbitrary flight suddenly removes the support cost, the final choice becomes empty.
Keep the first two before/contact/after events readable before maximal acceleration. New face plus vanished support must coexist in a comprehensible view.
Acknowledge Balance as nearest work and preserve the load-bearing difference; avoid a long grey void tableau of interchangeable figures on one tilting square.
Do not merge B’s time-allocation rule. Borrowing sampled motion is a technique choice and needs no second world rule.

concept: B — 借我一帧 / LEND ME A FRAME
core_sentence: A newcomer requires a moment when everyone else is still, so existing people surrender parts of their own motion to let others begin.

nearest_works.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
nearest_works.difference: First-party craft notes establish stepped animation on twos as a graphic device. This pitch changes cadence into a transferable resource, but spectators must perceive transfer rather than ordinary stylization.

nearest_works.title: In Time
nearest_works.difference: Writer comparator: exchangeable lifespan is a familiar scaffold, while this pitch exchanges screen movement. No independent full-film review in this pass.

nearest_works.title: The Lego Movie
nearest_works.difference: Writer comparator: material and temporal stylization are not a resource-exchange plot. No independent full-film review in this pass.

formal_invention: The cost is the loss of a character’s own animation frames, enacted in the viewing experience.

banned_touched.note: Held poses can be mistaken for the familiar slideshow default; transfer must be visible.
Talking about frames can become a self-congratulatory film about its production. No philosophical speech is proposed.

median_touched.note: Local shared-resource cooperation, not saving the world.

details: Stepped animation on twos is documented as part of the graphic treatment.

complaint: Deliberate low cadence may look like a production defect, while explaining it competes with the song.
notes: Strongest formal conceit but weaker fit for 43.670 seconds and an audience reading many AI identities.

Do not upgrade material because the reviewer found a famous animation technique. Real practitioner detail must determine the resource rule.
If developed later, resolve why everyone freezing creates time rather than merely preventing all births.
Short distance searches found no exact frame-donation match but are incomplete; no novelty claim. Peak time-series checks were inaccessible as recorded in A’s audit.

concept: C — 明天先洗出来 / TOMORROW DEVELOPS FIRST
core_sentence: A photograph develops backward in time, forcing the people in it to alter their actions so that its missing photographer can exist.

nearest_works.title: Time Lapse
nearest_works.difference: Official press notes establish photographs showing a future 24 hours ahead. Backward development modifies the device but does not sufficiently displace the familiar future-photo causal puzzle.

nearest_works.title: Back to the Future
nearest_works.difference: Writer comparator: a changing family photograph already makes existence visibly conditional on altered events. No new independent full-film review in this pass.

nearest_works.title: Arrival
nearest_works.difference: Reclassification of apparently earlier images is familiar; this pitch adds photographic material but weaker human stakes. Calibration only.

formal_invention: Successive photographs reclassify earlier preparations, but a plain mystery retelling retains much of the premise.

banned_touched.note: Disconnected symbolic preparations risk replacing causal scenes.

median_touched.note: Final group photograph is modified by its missing photographer; close enough to need substantial reinvention, but not scored as an outright gate failure solely for including a photograph.
